violated_contract: A claim that isolates a shared resource must exclusive-lock the resource identifier that consumers actually bind, not a proxy key that can alias two different derived values. Harness sessions claim TCP ports; claiming the offset number lets two offsets whose role defaults intersect (llm_gateway at +1000 and redis at +3700 both yield 10080) both succeed.
canonical_prevention: O_EXCL-claim each derived port number, including cross-role intersections, roll back a partial offset if any port is taken, and assert disjoint occupancy across the whole offset space rather than pinning two known colliding offsets.
